items.title: Mitchel McAllister Interview, 1960-03-19
items.q: I think it's James Scott wrote that, you know.

ctx.x: I don't know about the Maple Leaf, yes. I don't know about the Frog Lake, I can't remember. It might have been that, but it wasn't that Frog Lake here.
I think that's James Scott or Scott Joplin. I can't remember which one. I think it's James Scott wrote that, you know. Scott Joplin wrote Maple Leaf and so many other
good ones. Easy one is one of my favorites. That's a pretty hot number.
